const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /tmp/repair_w58_verify.py
+import json
+import re
+import subprocess
+import sys
+from pathlib import Path
+
+ROOT = Path("/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation")
+sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "tools"))
+
+from i18nlib.config import load_manifest
+from i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
+from i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
+
+BASE = "12376f4bfd991734907d9d2afa08bc7fba0abb0f"
+FILES = ("mod-tome.lua", "tome-cults.lua", "tome-orcs.lua")
+WORKSET = json.loads((ROOT / ".ai/task/repair-w58-20261001/WORKSET.json").read_text())
+EXPECTED_KEYS = {
+    (item["normalized_path"], item["source"], item.get("source_tag"))
+    for item in WORKSET["items"]
+}
+
+manifest = load_manifest()
+runtime = LuaRuntime(manifest)
+runtime.doctor()
+loader = LocaleLoader(runtime)
+
+
+def git_bytes(path):
+    result = subprocess.run(
+        ["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{path}"],
+        cwd=ROOT,
+        stdout=subprocess.PIPE,
+        stderr=subprocess.PIPE,
+        check=False,
+    )
+    assert result.returncode == 0, result.stderr.decode("utf-8", "replace")
+    return result.stdout
+
+
+def comparable(record):
+    return {key: value for key, value in record.items() if key not in {"line", "logical_path"}}
+
+
+def record_map(document, path):
+    result = {}
+    for record in document.records:
+        key = (
+            path,
+            record.get("source"),
+            record.get("source_tag"),
+            record.get("function_name"),
+            record.get("kind"),
+        )
+        assert key not in result, ("duplicate record identity", key)
+        result[key] = record
+    return result
+
+
+changed = []
+records_total = 0
+translations_total = 0
+file_results = {}
+for path in FILES:
+    before_bytes = git_bytes(path)
+    after_bytes = (ROOT / path).read_bytes()
+    before = loader.load_bytes(before_bytes, logical_path=path)
+    after = loader.load_path(ROOT / path, logical_path=path)
+    records_total += len(after.records)
+    translations_total += len(after.translations)
+    before_map = record_map(before, path)
+    after_map = record_map(after, path)
+    assert before_map.keys() == after_map.keys(), f"record identities changed: {path}"
+    file_changed = []
+    for key in before_map:
+        old = before_map[key]
+        new = after_map[key]
+        if comparable(old) != comparable(new):
+            assert old.get("kind") == new.get("kind") == "translation"
+            target_key = (path, old["source"], old.get("source_tag"))
+            assert target_key in EXPECTED_KEYS, ("non-target record changed", target_key)
+            assert {
+                name: old.get(name)
+                for name in ("function_name", "kind", "section", "source", "source_tag", "args_order", "special")
+            } == {
+                name: new.get(name)
+                for name in ("function_name", "kind", "section", "source", "source_tag", "args_order", "special")
+            }, ("non-target field changed", target_key)
+            token_pattern = re.compile(r"%(?:\d+\$)?[-+ #0]*(?:\d+|\*)?(?:\.\d+|\.\*)?[hlL]?[diouxXeEfgGcrsq%]|<\?.*?\?>|#\{[^}]+\}#|\[/?i\]")
+            assert token_pattern.findall(old["target"]) == token_pattern.findall(new["target"]), ("markup changed", target_key)
+            file_changed.append(target_key)
+            changed.append(target_key)
+    before_lines = before_bytes.splitlines(keepends=True)
+    after_lines = after_bytes.splitlines(keepends=True)
+    assert len(before_lines) == len(after_lines), ("line count changed", path)
+    assert [line.strip(b"\r\n") == b"" for line in before_lines] == [line.strip(b"\r\n") == b"" for line in after_lines], ("blank-line positions changed", path)
+    assert [line.count(b"\t") for line in before_lines] == [line.count(b"\t") for line in after_lines], ("TAB structure changed", path)
+    assert before_bytes.count(b"\r\n") == after_bytes.count(b"\r\n") == 0, ("not LF-only", path)
+    assert before_bytes.endswith(b"\n") == after_bytes.endswith(b"\n"), ("terminal newline changed", path)
+    file_results[path] = {
+        "records": len(after.records),
+        "translations": len(after.translations),
+        "changed_targets": len(file_changed),
+        "sha256": after.sha256,
+    }
+
+assert set(changed) == EXPECTED_KEYS, ("changed target set mismatch", len(changed), len(EXPECTED_KEYS))
+assert len(changed) == 3
+cults_text = (ROOT / "tome-cults.lua").read_text()
+expected_new = (
+    "他们高举盾牌，步调一致地缓缓向城墙逼近。",
+    "很快，不死族开始组织自己，然后步调一致地朝我们的方向推进。",
+)
+expected_old = (
+    "他们高举盾牌，一步一步地向墙走去。",
+    "很快，不死族开始组织自己，然后朝着我们的方向移动。",
+)
+assert all(cults_text.count(value) == 1 for value in expected_new)
+assert all(value not in cults_text for value in expected_old)
+
+print(json.dumps({
+    "result": "passed",
+    "lua": runtime.doctor(),
+    "files": file_results,
+    "records_total": records_total,
+    "translations_total": translations_total,
+    "changed_targets": len(changed),
+    "changed_set_exact": True,
+    "other_records_unchanged": records_total - len(changed),
+    "non_target_fields_unchanged": True,
+    "lf_tab_blank_terminal_invariants": True,
+    "placeholder_markup_template_invariants": True,
+    "cycle_1_fragments_exact": True,
+}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
*** End Patch";
text(await tools.apply_patch(patch));
